geometry.note: No checks[] row: the 71-station sd750 flag and the collaboration's own quoted '61-detector, 23.5 km2' infill figure do not obviously describe the same set (see method); asserting a check against a figure that may not match this shape would be dishonest, not merely imprecise.

method: Convex hull of the 71 stations flagged sd750=1 in the Auger open-data station table sdMap.csv (49 sd750-only plus 22 flagged both sd1500 and sd750), using the same UTM-to-WGS84 conversion and hull algorithm as the Auger SD-1500 array boundary. The computed area is 29.3 km^2, 24.7% above the 23.5 km^2 quoted for the '61-detector infilled array' in a collaboration publication. The 71-station sd750 flag count also does not match the quoted 61 detectors, so the flag very likely uses a looser definition of 'infill station' than the one behind the quoted figure. For that reason no check against the quoted area is asserted.
name: Pierre Auger Observatory infill surface-detector array (750 m spacing), convex hull
notes: The area (29.3 km^2) does not match the collaboration's quoted '23.5 km^2, 61-detector' infill figure closely enough to assert a check; the sd750 flag likely covers a superset (for example including AMIGA/HEAT-related stations) of the specific infill array that figure describes.
Licence: sdMap.csv is released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (opendata.auger.org home page), so the derived geometry carries that licence name and attribution.

summary.plain: A smaller, more closely packed patch of detector tanks near the centre of the Auger array, added to catch lower-energy cosmic rays.
